navigate.summary: Ask the host to show another route.

finish.summary: Close the screen the app runs in.

openUrl.summary: Open a URL in the app the system chooses.

pickFile.summary: Let the user pick a file with the system picker.
pickFile.detail: The host copies the pick into the app's media cache and answers with ViewModel.on_file_picked; the bytes never cross the bridge.

request.description: Handed back with the answer, to tell picks apart.

accept.description: A MIME type such as image/*, which opens the photo picker, or */* for any file.

edges.shape: {top, bottom, start, end}, each a dimension

enum.shape: one of a declared value set

brush.shape: a color, or {type: linear|radial, colors, stops}
